title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 325 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 325 - Power to Compound Offences The Commissioner may, with the prior approval of the Board, before or after the institution of any proceeding or suit, commit a compromise before or after the commencement of prosecution proceedings for an offense punishable under this Part. In the event of a conflict between the information on this website and the original Government publications or notifications of laws, rules, regulations, and SROs, the Government publications or notifications shall prevail.
